prompt: Make a character sprite for my game in this image's exact art style: high resolution shaded pixel art, gritty, dark and desaturated, muted colors, same lighting and same top-down three-quarter camera angle and same character scale as the reference. It is an enemy of the undead lich's army: a champion of the holy human crusade, a direct foil to the undead. Worn, battle-scarred ivory and tarnished gold, weathered steel, off-white cloth stained with mud and soot, deep crimson trim, and soft warm holy-light glows (pale candle gold) where the undead have necrotic green; still muted and gritty enough to sit on the same dark battlefield. The subject is the United Kings, a boss: three crowned armored kings marching shoulder to shoulder as one tight group, the central king a giant in gold-trimmed plate with a great crown, a heavy royal mantle and a warhammer, flanked by two smaller crowned kings, one carrying a royal banner and one a lance, each in different heraldic tabards. Full bodies, marching, facing right. They are the ONLY figures, standing together in an open, empty patch of the dark battlefield ground with nothing touching or overlapping it, fully visible with clear space around it. Not a cartoon, not bright, no saturated colors.
